content.text:
**Voice message:**

"Okay so, quick one. I opened this page about putting money into an S&P 500 fund every month. Basically it says to go with **Pasgot (פסגות) as the account and the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 index fund (ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), number 5139282)**. I'm fairly sure, but not totally. What sold me is the giant number at the top: **86,492 ₪**, with 'הכי הרבה נשאר בזוג הזה', so the most is left with that pair. The other thing is the fund's fees say '0%' and '0%', with something tiny like '0.02%'. I didn't really get that the page is putting in 10,000 ₪ up front, not my 14k. It says '10,000 ₪ עכשיו ועוד 500 ₪ בחודש, 120 חודשים', so 10,000 now plus 500 a month for 120 months, 70,000 ₪ in total. I didn't find where to put my own amounts.

What I looked at, in order: the big number up top. Then the 'כמה כל בחירה משנה' bit, how much each choice changes things. It has lines with little ticks on them. I got that the account matters more, like '22,985 ₪', and the fund only '4,492 ₪', but honestly the ticks with the colours meant nothing until I matched them to the key at the bottom. Then the fund card on the left: Yelin, 0%, 0%, 0.02%. Then the account list on the right, with Pasgot first at 86,492, then Leumi (לאומי) and Interactive Brokers (ואן זירו is how it reads on screen), around 83k each.

Words I didn't get: 'דמי משמרת', and Pasgot shows '699 ₪' of them, so is that a fee?? Also 'צוברת', 'מנוטרל מט"ח', '4D', 'נאמן', and 'משתנה / קבוע' next to the 0%. Plus a line under Leumi that says 'לא בחשבון', not in the calculation, something about a different price for young people and students. Wait, I'm a student?? I didn't open it.

Where I'd have closed it: the list of funds, the 'כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500' part. Every single row has the same coloured tags again: 'קרן מחקה', 'צוברת', 'חשיפה לדולר', and so on. I was rereading the same pills on every row just to find the one that's different. That's where I'd have swiped away."

**Short account:** I read the top summary, the first chart, the fund card and the first two account rows. I skimmed the filter chips and the grey explanation text above the account list. I skipped the Leumi fold, the 'התעריפון' link and 'קיבלתם מחיר אחר?'. I got stuck on what 4,492 and 22,985 compare against, and on the coloured bars in the account rows, where the numbers sit away from the colours they belong to.

input.answer: Open an account at Pasgot and buy the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) index fund (5139282). The page says this pair leaves the most, 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, and the fund's fees show as 0%.

stuck.why: It assumes 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 a month, and I couldn't see where to put in my own amounts
The coloured ticks only make sense through the key at the bottom, and I wasn't sure what 22,985 and 4,492 are compared against
The fee amounts are written under the bars, so I had to match colour squares to bar parts by looking back and forth
It mentions a price for students that isn't in the calculation, so I wasn't sure if Leumi would actually be cheaper for me

Whether the money is locked or I can take it out

findings.what: Fee amounts are written apart from the coloured bar parts they belong to, so I had to match colours back and forth
The chart ticks' meaning is only in a colour key at the bottom, away from the lines
The deposit amounts are fixed (10,000 + 500 a month) and not obviously editable
The student price is mentioned but not counted, which might change the answer for me
Jargon is never explained: דמי משמרת, צוברת, מנוטרל מט"ח
